author: SickProdigy
chatgpt-codex
description: Post configurable new movie release announcements from TMDb to a Discord channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild movie release announcement settings and posted movie IDs. It does not persistently store user data or metadata.
install_msg: Set your TMDb API key with `[p]movieset apikey`, choose a channel with `[p]movieset channel`, optionally set a notification role with `[p]movieset role`, then enable announcements with `[p]movieset enabled true`.
name: MovieReleases
